name: Super Bouncer Henry
description:
About This Game

Super Bouncer Henry is a light hearted Third Person Single Player Action Rouge Like with Horde Shooter Mechanics, 3D Platforming and Cell Shading aesthetics.

Core Mechanics:

-Equip up to 6 Items on the Main Character and find out wich combination works best for you
-Fight your way through a series of Rooms, each containing progressively stronger enemies
-Get rewared with Item Skills and Upgrades every time you clear a Room
-Fight a Boss after each Level
-Finish all levels to beat the game
-Optimize your builds and upgrade your Character
short_desc: Fight and Bounce your way through endless waves of enemies and grow powerful! Grab loot, level up and upgrade your Character to create unique and crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!
